chunks: Alas the woe that day for those who deny!

key_terms.لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ: For the deniers, those who rejected the truth
key_terms.وَيْلٌ: Woe or calamity, a cry of distress in Hell
key_terms.يَوْمَئِذٍ: That day, referring to the Day of Judgment

ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of 'Wail' for the deniers in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Al-Mursalat (77:24) underscores the inevitable divine retribution for those who persistently deny the truth, linking their worldly rejection to eternal suffering. It serves as a warning that the 'woe' (Wail) is not merely a future event but a direct consequence of their entrenched disbelief, resonating with the concept of *Barzakh* as a precursor to the final judgment.
